message: input sketch must be the absolute path of an existing file; "relative" is a relative path
step "staff" slot "invalid" harness "wrong" cannot start seats; use claude-code or openai-codex or pi
orchestrated step "orchestration" needs exactly one controller slot; it has 0
step "staff" slot "retired" uses retired role "critic"; staff it with another role or none, or bring the role back
step "empty" has no slots; add a slot and staff it
mission admission-findings has no input named "unexpected"; its inputs are topic, sketch
step "staff" slot "open" needs a harness and effort, and optionally a role
